description: This Kotlin source file defines the PrayerNotificationScheduler class, which manages scheduling, canceling, and retrieving prayer notifications using Android's AlarmManager. It handles setting precise alarms for prayer times, ensuring alarms are not duplicated, and provides utility functions to format and store schedule metadata.

classes.name: PrayerNotificationScheduler
classes.description: A class responsible for scheduling and managing prayer notification alarms using Android's AlarmManager, with support for exact and inexact alarms, cancelation, and schedule metadata persistence.

methods.name: scheduleForToday
methods.description: Schedules alarms for today's prayer times, de-duplicating existing alarms, and storing schedule metadata.

methods.name: cancelAll
methods.description: Cancels all known alarms for today and tomorrow, and resets schedule metadata.

methods.name: getNextScheduledEpochMillis
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the next scheduled alarm in epoch milliseconds if available.

methods.name: recordLastStatus
methods.description: Records a human-readable status string for debugging and UI display.

methods.name: cancelForDate
methods.description: Cancels all alarms scheduled for a specific date.

methods.name: buildAlarmPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent for a specific prayer alarm with extras.

methods.name: scheduleAlarm
methods.description: Schedules an alarm at the given epoch time, choosing between exact and inexact methods based on device capabilities.

methods.name: canScheduleExactAlarms
methods.description: Checks if the device supports scheduling exact alarms.

methods.name: requestCodeFor
methods.description: Generates a stable, unique request code for alarms based on date and prayer.
